text:
Ethan (Support): @Sofia quick heads-up — Prospect HelioHealth prod embed ingestion throwing 429s & some 503s. Ticket INC-4987. Affecting ~12% of search traffic, customers seeing partial results. Can CS take a priority handback? :rotating_light:

Sofia (CS): On it. Need severity, mitigation status, and whether this touches their renewals. Marco/Lina FYI.

Lina (Solutions): I looked at logs — looks like a batch-job spike causing KV cache pressure -> upstream 503s and rate-limit 429s. Short-term: throttle the batch job and reduce batch_size. I can push a canary with a soft-drop policy.

Marco (AE): Heads-up — HelioHealth renewal in 9 days. Enterprise account; this is high-risk if unresolved >24h. Exec sponsor should be looped if we don't have a fix quickly.

Priya (CSM): I can own customer comms. Recommend acknowledging within 30m, give mitigation steps and ETA, offer goodwill credit if SLA breached.

Ethan (Support): Took action: throttled back the nightly batch and kicked off a hotfix deploy (embed-ingest v2.1.3) to canary. Patch reduces parallelism and adds backoff.

ops-bot: Deployment triggered: embed-ingest v2.1.3 -> canary (deploy-789). CI: ✅, Health checks: ⚠️ (some 503s still).

Sofia (CS): Comms plan (quick):
- 0-30m: Priya send initial ack and outline mitigation + ETA.
- 0-24h: Customer updates every 2h until stable.
- >24h: Marco: exec sponsor + renewal team briefing.
- Post-incident: joint postmortem + credit decision (Sofia will own).

Priya (CSM): Draft ack: "Hi Jason — we’re seeing partial embed failures affecting search. We’ve throttled ingestion and deployed a targeted fix. Next update in 2 hours. Apologies for the disruption; we’re prioritizing this." Will send in ~8m and paste copy here.

Lina (Solutions): Customer-side mitigation snippet to share with engineering contact:```python
# reduce batch size + enable retry backoff
client.embed(items, batch_size=256, retry_backoff=0.5)
```
This should drop peak token/sec by ~30%.

Ethan (Support): Canary metrics: token/sec down 30%, error rate from 28% -> 7%. Patch looks promising.

Sofia (CS): Good signal. Priya — after initial ack, keep 2h cadence and paste replies. Marco — pls loop exec sponsor and legal (renewal sensitivity). Lina — confirm RCA ETA. Ethan — keep INC-4987 updated with logs.

Marco (AE): Looping in exec sponsor now and flagging renewal ops. DMing sponsor + legal.

Priya (CSM): Sent first customer update (cc: cs@redwood). Customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick update, we'll monitor." Marking renewal risk as high until 48h stable.

ops-bot: Deployment complete: embed-ingest v2.1.3 -> 100% (deploy-789). Health checks: ✅

Ethan (Support): Incident mitigated. I'll run 48h monitoring, attach logs & metrics to INC-4987, and schedule postmortem with Lina.

Sofia (CS): Summary / owners: Priya — customer cadence (2h). Marco — exec/renewal escalation. Lina/Ethan — RCA + postmortem. Sofia — credit decision + comms to renewal ops. 

Sofia (CS): Thanks team. Keep updates here; if anything regresses, mark as P1 and ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
